name: table-column-move-left
description: A table column beside a left-pointing arrow.
useCase: Move a selected table column to the left.
misuse: Give the control an accessible name that specifies the table action.

16.reason: The selected area or complete arrow stays clear against the cell guides, within the square drawing frame.

24.reason: The cell structure and complete action mark retain clear separation and matched margins around the square drawing frame.
